files.name: ASMDEMO.BIN
files.about: machine code for the ELEC-16, assembled for the code area (7000).
files.help:
LOAD ▸ loads it and runs it at once (CALL 28672): the screen clears, the last text row fills with diamonds, and a line of text appears above BASIC's prompt.
Read how it is done with U 7000 in the monitor (MON), or EXPORT it.

files.name: BIORHYTH.BAS
files.about: THREE CYCLES FROM A BIRTH DATE TO TODAY
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Type your birth year, month and day, ENTER after each.
It shows the days lived and today's physical (23-day), emotional (28-day) and intellectual (33-day) cycles, from -100 to 100%, using the machine's date.

files.name: BOUNCE.BAS
files.about: A BALL IN A BOX; ANY KEY ENDS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. A ball bounces in a box drawn round the screen, beeping at each wall.
Any key ends it.

files.name: CANNON.BAS
files.about: HIT THE TARGET; ARROWS AIM, SPACE FIRES, Q ENDS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. A target lies on the ground to the right; your cannon is at the bottom left. The up and down arrows turn the barrel five degrees, the left and right arrows one (1 to 89: aim low on a wide screen), SPACE fires, and the shell leaves its arc on the screen.
Five shots, then it says how many hit. Q ends it early.

files.name: CHAT.BAS
files.about: TALK WITH THE AI THROUGH LINK
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Turn LINK and its AI on in the panel's LINK and choose a provider first.
Pick a type by its number, then type a question; the AI's answer is typed out. A question in kana is answered in kana.
ENTER alone opens the menu: 1 another type, 2 a new talk, 3 the end.

files.name: CLOCK.BAS
files.about: THE TIME AND THE DATE; ANY KEY ENDS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. The time and the date, read again four times a second.
Any key ends it.

files.name: HITBLOW.BAS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. The machine picks three different digits; guess them.
Type three digits and ENTER: a HIT is a right digit in the right place, a BLOW a right digit in another place. Three hits wins, and it says in how many tries.

files.name: LANDER.BAS
files.about: LAND ON THE MOON, BURNING 0 TO 30 UNITS A SECOND
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Land on the moon from 500 m, falling at 50 m/s, with 250 units of fuel.
Each second, type a burn from 0 to 30 and ENTER (T time, H height, V speed down, F fuel). A burn of 10 holds the speed; touch down under 5 m/s to land safely.

files.name: MAZE.BAS
files.about: A MAZE OF SLASHES; ANY KEY ENDS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Slashes and backslashes at random fill the screen as it scrolls: a maze that never ends.
Any key ends it.

files.name: PRIMES.BAS
files.about: THE PRIMES UP TO A NUMBER
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Type a number and ENTER: every prime up to it is printed.
A large number takes a while; BRK stops it.

files.name: SINEWAVE.BAS
files.about: A SINE AND HALF A COSINE ACROSS THE SCREEN; ANY KEY ENDS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Two cycles of a sine wave and a cosine at half the height, drawn dot by dot across the screen, on any LCD.
Any key ends it.

files.name: TICKER.BIN
files.about: a message typed in rolls across the LCD, moved by MCPY; any key ends it.
files.help:
LOAD ▸ loads it and runs it at once (CALL 28672). Type a message of up to a row and ENTER (ENTER alone shows the machine's own words): it rolls across the middle of the screen a dot at a time, moved by one MCPY on the ROM's timer.
Any key ends it and clears the screen. Read how it is done with U 7000 in the monitor (MON), or EXPORT it.

files.name: UNITS.BAS
files.about: FROM ONE UNIT TO ANOTHER; 0 ENDS
files.help:
LOAD ▸, then RUN. Choose 1 inches to cm, 2 miles to km, 3 pounds to kg or 4 °F to °C, then type the value.
It asks again for the next; 0 ends.
